lines.text: Messengers from the Wilderness of Kedemoth offered Sihon peace and promised silver for food and water.
Sihon refused passage because the LORD made his spirit stubborn, and his whole army came out at Hazor.
We captured all of Sihon's cities and carried off only the livestock and the plunder.
Og king of Bashan and his whole army met us in battle at Edrei, and the LORD delivered them.
We captured all sixty of Og's cities and took the land from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Carmel.
